subject: Visibility report: scan cadence, fix pipeline, and CVE closure expectations
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithpayments.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@thirdpartyaudit.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility request — scan cadence, CVE closure timelines

Hi Sofia / Kim,

Zenith is preparing for our SOC 2 refresh and the audit team has asked for a concise "visibility pack" on vulnerability management covering the last 90 days plus remediation commitments for active CVEs. Specifically we need:

- Canonical scan cadence (authenticated scans, SCA, container image scans, and any on-demand capability)
- SLA commitments for Critical / High / Medium CVEs (time-to-remediate and any exception process)
- Current status and remediation timeline for CVE-2026-4512 (we flagged this in our last exchange)
- Proof artifacts: scan summaries/CSV, evidence of patch deployment or compensating controls where applicable
- Preferred format for evidence intake (Drive folder vs signed attestation PDF vs portal upload)

Could you please send a short visibility report (one page + attachments) we can hand to the auditor by EOD Thursday PST? If you need to loop in engineering for timelines, please do — but note the auditor will expect an ETA and proof plan.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Security Assurance Lead — Zenith Payments
[external contact: +1 415 555 0112]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:25 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility request — scan cadence, CVE closure timelines

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear list — attaching a compact visibility packet and answering each bullet below. Attachment: scan-summary-q3.xlsx (spreadsheet with last 90 days summary and recent findings).

1) Scan cadence and tooling (short):
- Weekly authenticated infrastructure + application scans (credentialed Nessus for infra, internal auth scanners for app CVEs)
- Daily lightweight SCA (software composition analysis) for repos and container images (Trivy-based pipeline)
- Container image scanning on every build in CI; nightly bulk image re-scan for registry
- Monthly external penetration test window (rotating scope); ad-hoc scans available on request with 24h notice

2) SLA commitments (company policy / production practice):
- Critical: remediation or compensating control within 7 calendar days; emergency hotfix process with 48h expedited patch where risk requires
- High: remediation within 30 calendar days; mitigation tracking and backport plan documented
- Medium/Low: triage and release-window scheduling (typical 90-day horizon)
- Exceptions: documented review with Security + SRE and escalation ledger (this is recorded in the Drive folder).

3) CVE-2026-4512 (status):
- Discovery: 2026-10-22 (internal scan flagged library X vulnerability)
- Current state: temporary mitigation (WAF rule + reduced permissions) implemented 2026-10-28
- Owner: SRE (ticket RDW-1198) assigned to Monica Patel
- Committed remediation: targeted code change + dependency update, staging rollout 2026-11-18, production rollout 2026-11-24 (post-verification)
- Remediation evidence will be provided as: patch PR link, CI build artifacts, and post-deploy scans (result CSV).

4) Proof artifacts and format:
- Attached: scan-summary-q3.xlsx (summary + per-host findings)
- Attached: CVE-2026-4512-remediation-plan.pdf (detailed plan)
- We can provide Drive folder access (link below) for bulk artifacts; if you need a signed attestation PDF for the auditor we can produce and sign via DocuSign — please confirm which you prefer.

If you need an explicit SLA letter with signature for your SOC 2 binder, say the word and I will route it to Legal for a signed PDF by EOD Friday.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: scan-summary-q3.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithpayments.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:45:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility request — scan cadence, CVE closure timelines

Elena / Sofia — quick operational note to support the visibility packet:

- Patch/maintenance windows: weekly Tue 02:00–04:00 PST is our standard production maintenance window. For Critical CVEs we will execute the emergency hotfix process (can be pushed outside the window) and target a 48 hour turnaround from fix approval.
- Release practice: changes go through canary in staging, automated smoke tests, and a 24–48h monitoring hold before full rollout.
- Artifacts: I’ve added patch-release-notes.md to the Drive folder (small file with exact PRs and rollout timestamps).

On CVE-2026-4512 specifically — Monica is leading the patch and we have a tentative production date (11/24). If Zenith needs test access to staging to validate the mitigation before prod, we can grant a time-limited account (please let us know the contact and scope).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Reliability Engineering | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: patch-release-notes.md]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithpayments.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@thirdpartyaudit.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility request — scan cadence, CVE closure timelines

Thanks Sofia and Kim — this is exactly the level of detail the auditor wants. A couple of quick asks:

1) Please put the full evidence bundle into the Drive folder linked below (we will pull artifacts directly).
2) For the SOC 2 binder we need either: (a) a signed attestation PDF stating the SLA commitments and the specific CVE remediation plan for CVE-2026-4512, or (b) a HubSpot record with formal acceptance and timestamps. Can you confirm which option you prefer?
3) If you can provide a DocuSign-ready PDF by EOD Friday that references RDW-1198 and lists the production rollback plan, that will close the auditor’s ask.

Rajiv (cc) — feel free to flag anything else you need from Redwood to satisfy the control objective.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena
Elena Torres
Security Assurance Lead — Zenith Payments
[Requested delivery: signed PDF or HubSpot acceptance by 2026-11-13]
